title: All About Beetles
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about beetles.

pages.brief: A shiny black beetle resting on top of a mossy log in a log pile.
A close-up of the beetle showing its hard, glossy black wing case on its back.
A clear view of the beetle from above, its six legs visible underneath it.
The beetle with its legs pulled in close to its body, tucked tight.
The beetle crawling under a loose flap of bark on the log.
The beetle pushing against a small piece of soft, rotten wood.
The beetle burrowing into the soft, crumbly wood of the old log.
Ned the duckling leaning in to look closely at the beetle on the log pile.
Ned the duckling examining the glossy black shell of the beetle up close.
Ned the duckling smiling, the beetle resting calmly on the log beside him.
